chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from one of his companions, from the cousin of Al-Wazaie, from Mas'ada ibn Al-Yasa', from Qays Al-Bahili, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)
that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) used to love to smell the sesame oil.
ai.seo_question: What scent did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) prefer?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) preference for sesame oil (*dahn al-simsim*), reflecting the Shia emphasis on the Prophet’s personal practices (*sunnah*) as a model for daily life. Sesame oil was highly valued in early Islamic culture not only for its pleasant fragrance but also for its medicinal and cosmetic benefits, illustrating the integration of physical well-being with spiritual etiquette. This narration serves as a basis for scholars to discuss the permissibility and virtue of using natural scents and oils in personal hygiene.
